test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'VTPM' is coded as '37' and 'CGNK' is coded as '73'. How will 'MVLC' be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'VTPM' is coded as '37'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c78b7431f369a09ddfb83cbd5799a7e0074be75f4221d3e7d9c5a0a824aca68.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b00a0c054011325ad0ba063ac740ec8b13d4da164c955ac09a8507f030f58c9b.png] 

'CGNK' is coded as '73'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f12f4c492b61db71cebaf2961ab4ad8453a24f2e38aff6ec895691642a979e30.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53ac4863087dac95ff1ffbd31335d0919b5f372fce8502c83276567a52417175.png] 

Similarly, 'MVLC' will be coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62d3f64982b9fd23b3f612f1fc8c556134ce0e6c4ff75a2c052b07ea9da245b0.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8908cbca5d061da4c15cc5815bd3cb7775dd9b383aeea21021f8b6d1acacf1aa.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"58".**
